title: The Coast Guard's verdict: "This was preventable."

scenes.voiceover: Two years after the implosion, the Coast Guard released its final verdict on OceanGate. It was blunt.
In August 2025, the Coast Guard released its final 335-page report. In the words of the board's chair: this marine casualty and the loss of five lives was preventable.
Investigators found OceanGate's own inadequate engineering, a toxic workplace culture, and regulatory gaps wide enough to drive a submarine through.
The report went further. Had Stockton Rush survived, the Coast Guard says it would have referred him to the Justice Department for criminal investigation.
Two months later, the NTSB's own report found the hull had been silently failing since a 2022 dive — and that OceanGate never truly knew how weak it had become.
scenes.mainText: THEY NEVER KNEW HOW WEAK IT WAS
